What was the Iron age? The Iron Age explained.
The history from the Bronze age collapse to the rise of Persia, Greece, and Rome explained and summarized briefly.
If you enjoyed this video you will probably also enjoy this video I made about the different metals used in the iron age and how they impacted history.
Sources/related reading:

A history of the Ancient Near East (Wiley Backwell)
End of the Bronze Age (Robert Drews)
1177 (Eric Cline)
